title: Dental office in an existing leased medical suite — Ponce, zone X
description: I am a dentist opening my own dental office in an existing leased suite in a medical building in Ponce. No construction. One hygienist and one receptionist.

mustInclude.rationale: RULE_0002 municipality baseline: every business gets the IRS EIN; employees also trigger RULE_0620.
RULE_0003 municipality baseline: Registro de Comerciante (SURI).
RULE_0004 municipality baseline: Patente Municipal (Ley 107-2020 Codigo Municipal).
RULE_0007: a physical commercial premises -> Permiso Unico (Ley 161-2009).
Business-type rule: the licensed professional (veterinarian / dentist) must hold the Junta Examinadora license.

mustNotInclude.rationale: No construction stated: RULE_0643/0644 need a construction / renovation project type.
FEMA zone X (outside the SFHA): RULE_0706 needs location.flood_zone.sfha.
Commercial use in an existing building in an urban district: no rural/SREP consulta trigger.

ordering.rationale: KB documents.json: DOC_PATENTE_MUNICIPAL depends on DOC_PERMISO_UNICO.

notes: Added 2026-10-05 by the scenario loop: first dental-office scenario and first Ponce scenario.
